title: health_check_api_returns_status_ok
description: Verify that GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 with JSON body {"status":"ok"} when the service is running.

title: rooms_catalog_api_returns_seeded_rooms
description: Verify that GET /api/rooms returns HTTP 200 with the three seeded rooms including their id, slug, nombre, descripcion, capacidad, and tarifaNocheCop.

title: reservation_creation_with_valid_data
description: Verify that POST /api/reservations with valid roomSlug, checkIn, checkOut, guest data, and huespedes returns HTTP 201 with a reservation in PENDIENTE_PAGO state including noches, totalCop, and referencia, and that GET /api/reservations/{id} returns the stored reservation with room details.

title: reservation_creation_with_invalid_fields
description: Verify that POST /api/reservations with invalid input fields such as past check-in date, invalid email, or huespedes exceeding room capacity returns HTTP 400 with detailed field-level validation errors.

title: reservation_creation_with_unknown_roomslug
description: Verify that POST /api/reservations with an unknown roomSlug returns HTTP 404 with error message {"error":"Habitación no encontrada"}.

title: reservation_creation_with_date_conflict
description: Verify that POST /api/reservations for dates overlapping a CONFIRMADA reservation of the same room returns HTTP 409 with error message {"error":"La habitación ya tiene una reserva confirmada en esas fechas"}.

title: reservation_retrieval_with_missing_id
description: Verify that GET /api/reservations/{id} with a non-existent reservation id returns HTTP 404 with error message {"error":"Reserva no encontrada"}.

title: payu_confirmation_webhook_valid_request
description: Verify that POST /api/webhooks/payu with valid form-encoded merchant_id, reference_sale, value, currency, state_pol, sign, and transaction_id returns HTTP 200 OK, updates the matched reservation's transaction_id, and changes its status to CONFIRMADA or PAGO_RECHAZADO based on state_pol.

title: payu_confirmation_webhook_invalid_signature
description: Verify that POST /api/webhooks/payu with invalid signature or merchant_id returns HTTP 403 with text 'Firma inválida' and does not change any reservation.

title: payu_confirmation_webhook_unknown_reference_sale
description: Verify that POST /api/webhooks/payu with a reference_sale that does not match any reservation returns HTTP 404 with text 'Reserva no encontrada'.
